statement_assessments.concrete_obligation: Give an independent valid derivation of the literal product formula under the same hypotheses, or an exact violating model; alternatively correct the source to its existing additive ledger formula.

proof_obligations.reason: Condition row variance, average before using integrated q, one row union, and Jensen; no row independence or conditional square upgrade.
Exact without-replacement variance, deterministic optimizer, sign loss and endpoint deletion give 2sqrt(MQ/m)+2md/M.
Freeze a deterministic subset/sign/type assignment; H3 with zero tests and integrated column variance gives beta+sqrt(q).
Arbitrary good endpoints, capped infimum extension, b+a=L-1, and direct bounded-differences mgf proof.
Union only N extension tails after integrating types; count full-degree failure once, retain expected square mass.
